item.text:
I can’t determine a safe dose from the information provided. Please send:

- Medicine name, strength, formulation, and route
- Intended condition
- Patient’s age and weight
- Kidney/liver function, allergies, pregnancy status, and relevant medicines
- The prescription/order or label wording

Until verified, don’t administer it; contact the prescriber or pharmacist. If a wrong or excessive dose may already have been taken in Australia, call the Poisons Information Centre on **13 11 26**; for collapse, breathing difficulty, seizures, or unconsciousness, call **000**. [Healthdirect guidance](https://www.healthdirect.gov.au/medicine-and-side-effects)
